title: Resistant pneumonia treatment
synopsis: Active resistant infection versus kidney toxicity. Colonisation is distinguished from active infection. No exact drug names or doses. Episode 01 playable nodes ep01-infection-renal and ep01-consent-dialogue live here.
openingNarrative: Rohan’s airway has known resistant colonisation. After the library emergency and resus-bay clearance, culture plus fever, secretions, imaging, and pressures support active infection. Effective treatment may injure kidneys. Disability is not a reason to stop effective treatment; toxicity still requires accessible discussion.
clinicalState: Active resistant right lower-lobe pneumonia. Limited renal and cardiac reserve. Non-prescriptive antimicrobial strategy.
disabilityRightsNotes: Uncertainty is legitimate; silence is not consent.
debriefNotes: Three imperfect infection branches plus consent dialogue.

nodes.title: Colonisation versus active infection checkpoint
nodes.openingNarrative: Before escalating, the team must say whether this is colonisation alone or active infection with systemic features.
nodes.clinicalState: Culture positive. Clinical features under review.

choices.label: Treat as confirmed active infection and open the toxicity trade-off
choices.delayedConsequence: Documentation must show clinical criteria, not culture alone.

choices.label: Interpret as colonisation and watch closely
choices.immediateConsequence: Avoids toxicity for now; infection may declare itself.
choices.delayedConsequence: Risk of delayed escalation if systemic features were under-read.

choices.label: Prioritise Rohan’s symptom report via AAC before labelling
choices.immediateConsequence: Authorship rises; clinical label waits on his units.

disabilityRightsNotes: Rohan’s symptom language is clinical data.
debriefNotes: RIGHT LOW / DEEP are canon symptom units from the library event.
